categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Carries the P2P label and modifies net_processing.cpp to change peer timeout behavior during block download.
categories.rationale: Prevents dropping honest peers on slow connections where block responses take precedence over ping replies. Over slow connections, block responses can queue ahead of pongs past the 20-minute ping timeout; suspending the timeout while blocks are in flight fixes an unnecessary disconnection of functional peers during download.
